question: Harshacharita book was written by which of the following writers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Banabhatta**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Harshacharita** was written by **Banabhatta**, a court poet of Emperor Harsha.
 
• Banabhatta's work is one of the earliest examples of biographical writing in Sanskrit literature.
 
• The book provides a detailed account of the life and times of Emperor Harsha, including his conques
